Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Memnite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

5170-5931-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2757-3327-4247.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
2757-3327-4247.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

3899-7084-7885.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3132-3259-7175.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-7175.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1379-5641-6830-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-5641-6830-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

114-3263-7741.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

2267-3240-5256-6462.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2692-5412.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2692-5412.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1247-5268-7008.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

777-1017-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

413-1400-4619.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
When the Spirit creature token enters, the Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from Step 1.
Repeat.

1385-2173-4771-5220.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.

1902-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Wirewood Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.

539-2244-4803-5223.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

222-629-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-629-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Gruff Triplets and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Gruff Triplets die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Gruff Triplets' power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
Resolve the Shilgengar abilities
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Gruff Triplets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Slimefoot and Squue and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, creating two token copes of it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token.
When the Gruff Triplets token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1525-2178-4488-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zimone and Dina.
1525-2178-4488-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zimone and Dina triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability from step 1, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Rampaging Baloths triggers for each land that enters the battlefield this way, creating that many 4/4 Beast creature tokens.
Repeat.

1829-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
1829-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

232-2034-3458-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Urabrask on top of your library from your graveyard.
Actviate Impromptu Raid by paying {2}{R/G}, revealing Priest of Urabrask from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2760-4994.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
2760-4994.description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to one.
The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Nest of Scarabs and Blowfly Infestation trigger.
Resolve the Nest of Scarabs trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blowfly Infestation trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-4377-5163.notablePrerequisites: Roon does not have summoning sickness.
2493-4377-5163.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Roon by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Archaeomancer until the beginning of your end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Roon triggers, returning Archaeomancer from exile to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, putting Walk the Aeons into your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.
